name: Business KPI Reporting Dashboard
author: blinkmetrics

sections.description:
BlinkMetrics brings all your website data (and data from other SaaS tools you use to run your business) into one single source of truth. This plugin lets you bring all your WordPress data into BlinkMetrics (requires an active account with BlinkMetrics.

Out of the box, BlinkMetrics has everything you need to keep your whole company on the same page. Decide which KPIs to track during onboarding, then sit back and relax as BlinkMetrics automatically pulls that data and gives you a real-time look into your business.

How do you know if business is going well?

If you need to open a dozen browser tabs to answer that question, we promise there’s a better way.

BlinkMetrics automatically collects your KPIs and highlights where to focus your attention for maximum impact. With automated KPI tracking, you can catch problems early and identify growth opportunities.

It takes 30 seconds to schedule a demo; let’s build your single source of truth.

Automated KPI Reporting for WordPress & More!

Run a data-savvy operation without hiring developers or analysts. If you love a good spreadsheet, you’ll feel right at home with our automated scorecards. All the clarity you crave, none of the tedious copy/paste to get there.

Integrations with Popular WordPress Plugins:
* Easy Digital Downloads: Track sales data such as count of EDD licenses, customers, orders, and transactions.
* Simply Schedule Appointments: Track the count of appointments, payments, appointment types, resources, and staff.
* Gravity Forms: Track the count of forms and entries.
* Ninja Forms: Track the count of entries.
* Formidable Forms: Track the count of forms and entries.
* Fluent Forms: Track the count of forms and entries.
* WPForms: Track the count of entries.
* Elementor Pro: Track the count of forms and entries.

Integrations with WordPress Features:
* Users: Track user data, including registration and activity metrics.
* Posts: Published post data, including title, content, and metadata.
* Plugins: Track count of installed Plugins and Plugins with Updates Available

Getting Started

To begin exposing data to BlinkMetrics:

  1. Navigate to Tools > BlinkMetrics in your WordPress admin area.
  2. Choose the specific metrics you’d like to make accessible to BlinkMetrics and generate an API key.
  3. Add your website as a data source within BlinkMetrics, providing the API key that you generated in step 2.

Business KPI Reporting Dashboard is not just a tool for internal reporting but also a gateway to broader data utilization and external service enhancements.

Check out the full guide to begin automating your WordPress data tracking
sections.faq:
I have a question or need help with the plugin. How do I contact your support team?

To contact our support team, submit your message through our WordPress support forum. Or, you can also submit your message through our website’s Contact page.

How do I create an API key for my WordPress site?

After activating the plugin:

  • Navigate to Tools > Blink Metrics in your WordPress admin area.
  • Select the metrics you wish to track.
  • Click Generate API Key and copy the provided credentials.

How do I make a simple KPI report from my WordPress data?

After installing this plugin, paste the generated API key into your BlinkMetrics account. Then, select the metrics you want to see in your report.
